# Getting help with KeenDreams Security

KeenDreams Security is MIT-licensed open-source software. Paid services are
optional; deploying and using the complete project does not require buying
support from Agent9.

## Start with the guides

- [First-run walkthrough](../docs/start-here.md)
- [Cloudflare deployment and OAuth](../docs/deployment/README.md)
- [Tenable Hexa setup and test boundaries](../docs/integrations/tenable.md)
- [Verified behavior and known limitations](../docs/verification.md)

## Bugs and questions

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Agent9AI/keendreams-security/issues) for
reproducible bugs and non-sensitive questions. Include the commit or release,
whether the problem occurs locally or in a deployed environment, the smallest
reproduction, expected versus actual behavior, and the sanitized error code.

Do not include API keys, OAuth tokens, session cookies, private asset inventories,
or unredacted request headers. Use a minimal synthetic example where possible.
Community responses are best effort, without a guaranteed response time.

## Security vulnerabilities

Use the [private vulnerability-reporting process](SECURITY.md), not a public
issue or a general sales inquiry. The security policy describes the reporting
channel and acknowledgment target.

## Paid deployment and integration assistance

[Contact Agent9](https://agent9.dev/contact/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=support&utm_campaign=keendreams-security)
to discuss help with Cloudflare deployment, identity configuration, application
or agent integrations, and workflow evaluation.

Useful information for an initial conversation:

- The application or agent you want to connect and the outcome you need.
- Whether you need standalone memory or the optional Tenable workflow.
- Your deployment environment, integration stage, and target timeline.
- Whether you need implementation help, operational handover, or an ongoing
  support arrangement.

Send a description of the work, not credentials or raw security findings.
Engagement scope, fees, ongoing support, and any response commitments are agreed
separately. Agent9 services do not include Tenable licensing or a Tenable support
entitlement; provider account and licensing questions remain with that provider.
